title: Cork & Note
shortDescription: Your wine journal, personal AI sommelier, winery map and cellar in one app.
appleDescription:
Remember what you tasted. Discover what you like.

Cork & Note brings your wine journal, cellar and winery map together with an AI sommelier that uses your own tasting notes.

LOG ANY WINE, ANYWHERE
Remember a bottle at home, dinner out or a flight at the tasting bar. Add ratings, flavour notes and photos, and tag a place when you want to. Keep it quick or record the details.

SCAN A LABEL OR TASTING CARD
Use your camera or a photo to extract wine details. Review and edit the results before saving them to your journal.

EXPLORE WINERIES
Discover wineries, search the directory and revisit the places you have logged. Pro adds live Google ratings and opening hours where available.

ASK YOUR SOMMELIER
Get answers grounded in the wines you have rated and the bottles in your cellar. Ask what to open with dinner or what to try next. AI suggestions can make mistakes; check the details that matter to you.

MORE HELP WITH PRO
Scan a restaurant wine list for personalized picks, read a taste report based on your journal, plan a wine day and explore US wine regions on the map.

KEEP YOUR CELLAR
Track the bottles you own, record when you open one and use suggested drink windows to decide what to enjoy next.

YOUR JOURNAL, YOUR WAY
No public feed or followers. Ordinary tasting logs are unlimited, and your journal stays readable on Free or Pro. Online access is needed to sync and use AI features; the app tells you when you are offline.

Free includes limited AI use and cellar storage. Cork & Note Pro is an optional auto-renewing monthly or annual subscription. Pro features have fair-use limits described in the Terms of Use.

Cork & Note is for people of legal drinking age. Please drink responsibly.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings. Trial eligibility, current prices and renewal terms are shown before purchase.

Terms of Use: https://cork-and-note.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cork-and-note.vercel.app/privacy
